definitions.gloss: fake crying; crocodile tears; pretending to cry
definitions.explanation: crying that is not genuine, used to manipulate or deceive others

examples.japanese: あの{子|こ}は{嘘泣|うそな}きが{上手|じょうず}だ。
examples.english: That child is good at fake crying.

examples.japanese: {嘘泣|うそな}きして{親|おや}に{甘|あま}えた。
examples.english: I fake-cried to get attention from my parents.

examples.japanese: それは{嘘泣|うそな}きだと{見抜|みぬ}かれた。
examples.english: They saw through my fake crying.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{嘘|うそ} (lie) + {泣|な}き (crying)

USAGE:
Often associated with children trying to get their way, but can also refer to adults using tears manipulatively.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嘘泣|うそな}きする - to fake cry
- {嘘泣|うそな}きを{見抜|みぬ}く - to see through fake crying
- {嘘泣|うそな}きが{上手|じょうず} - good at fake crying

RELATED WORDS:
- {作|つく}り{笑|わら}い - fake smile
- もらい{泣|な}き - sympathetic crying (genuine)
- {号泣|ごうきゅう} - wailing (genuine)
